precedent: Spine: L1/L2 pinned posteriors (campaign-3 pins, AM-2026-08-10-001); premise realized by rejection, refusal on unfillable.

Flesh: verbatim panel months, 6-month mean blocks, entry severity per x_stress; joins bounded on 9 level factors + inflation era (<=2.5pp YoY); panel edge = forced re-entry, never wrap (owner ruling 2026-08-16).
Corrections: hazard = panel CRI-onset frequency per 4 investment-clock quadrants, conditioned on the month BEFORE onset; timing random by construction (R2/R3).

The severity table's values are pre-registration candidates pending D-SP-1; its inflation condition duplicates the quadrant hot bit (disclosed; owner ruling 2026-08-16: keep for pilot, revisit at D-SP-1).
crisis of 21 months at the worst decile: 1973-09 to 1974-12 ran -48% over exactly this span; 2007-10 to 2009-03 ran -50% over 17
no recovery segment: Japan 1990-2003 - within any ten-year window from the 1990 peak, no recovery arrived
the squeeze at the worst third: US 1966-1982 spent sixteen real-terms years below its 1966 level; the windows 1966-76 and 1972-82 both end underwater
all_down: 2022 ran equities and bonds down together, with no flight-to-quality bid
persistence: P1 re-entry + P2 declared coverage (40 of 40 quarters restricted) - D-SC-1 owner ruling 2026-08-15; percentiles unchanged from stress_1974 so the only new severity is the declared SHAPE

block length 6 months: the sealed benchmark bootstrap-v1 own mean (MEAN_BLOCK_MONTHS=6), adopted for stress segments per the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 after the generator-only coherence study (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-15-block-length-coherence-study.md) - depth was not consulted in the study or the choice

narrative.lesson: Every month in this decade is a real month from 1953-2020; only the sequence is new. What a bad YEAR cannot teach - the slow grind of a decade that never lets you back to even - this shape exists to teach.
narrative.summary: A DECLARED STRESS SCENARIO compiled by bootstrap-stratified: real 1953-2020 months, entered at severity-tilted percentiles per the declared x_stress rule - a 21-month worst-decile crisis and a worst-third squeeze covering every other quarter, with NO declared recovery. Precedent cited inline: 1973-74, 2007-09, 2022, US 1966-1982 in real terms, Japan 1990-2003. The persistence shape is the D-SC-1 ruling (P1 re-entry + P2 declared coverage). Severe and internally coherent by construction; not a probability-weighted forecast. This is the spine-conditioned compiler pilot world (world 802): a supply-shock premise realized by rejection sampling over pinned L1/L2 posteriors, then stitched from verbatim panel months under quadrant-conditioned hazard corrections - it is a pilot for pre-registered evaluation, not a ranked world.
